mapper.update: UPDATE learn_task SET title = #{task.title}, difficulty_level = #{task.difficultyLevel}, base_points = #{task.basePoints}, duration_minutes = #{task.durationMinutes}, scheduled_date = #{task.scheduledDate}, category_code = #{task.categoryCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remark = #{task.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reviewer_user_id = #{task.reviewerUserId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{task.id} AND status = 'DRAFT'
